requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-803-1486-4231--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1292-3117-5078-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2317-6763-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

141-413-1893.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-1893.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Shallow Grave.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

687-2034-3796-4613-8130.description:
Cast Gleaming Overseer by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Gleaming Overseer enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Gleaming Overseer and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Gleaming Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-3796-4613-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

2534-3817-4247-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-5708.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or Vizier of Tumbling Sands

116-1719-7786.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Vizier of Tumbling Sands has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

301-2813-6258.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-6258.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

1978-5793-6700-7008.description:
Activate Sarevok's Tome by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sarevok's Tome which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
1978-5793-6700-7008.notes: If you have completed a dungeon, you can activate Sarevok's Tome's last ability any number of times to cast all nonland cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3480-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1003-2997-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-2997-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7724.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

7-4779-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4779-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

6556-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with power 4 or greater.
6556-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least four cards this turn.
4668-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2191-6085-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2191-6085-6922.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Altanak and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1894-2173-5220-6578.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
1894-2173-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

973-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant

1550-2105-6800.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-6800.description:
Cast Keldon Strike Team by paying {2}{R}, causing it to give creatures you control haste since it entered the battlefield this turn.
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2723-5358.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to the creature with Blazing Sunsteel attached.
2723-5358.notablePrerequisites: The creature with Blazing Sunsteel attached is indestructible.
2723-5358.description:
Deal damage to the creature that has Blazing Sunsteel attached.
Blazing Susnteel triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the second Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to the creature it is attached to.
Repeat from step 2.

586-3967-5258-5618-6580.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

560-2438-3394-4550.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2438-3394-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Weatherlight Compleated triggers twice, putting two phyresis counters on it and causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Repeat.

3957-4613-4773.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
3957-4613-4773.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Overgrown Arch's first ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1267-4897-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai in your graveyard.Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1267-4897-5231.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Deal combat damage with Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Medomai, adding {R}.
Repeat.

296-2060-2292-2577.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
296-2060-2292-2577.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
The Thirteenth Doctor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

803-876-2525-4421-4951.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least fifty.
"Angel" or "Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-876-2525-4421-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Body Double's toughness.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Body Double.
Activate Body Double by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Priest of Fell Rites' toughness.
Repeat.

2882-3081.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Orah.
You have a Cleric creature card in hand with mana value 3 or less.
You have enough mana to cast the Cleric card in hand.
2882-3081.description:
Cast any Cleric with mana value three or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
The Cleric enters the battlefield as a copy of Orah due to Infinite Reflection.
Put the Cleric into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cleric dies, triggering itself and Orah.
Resolve the Orah trigger, returning the Cleric from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large amount of times.
Once you have a large amount of triggers on the stack, you may instead choose to put Orah into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and return all Clerics with mana value three or less from your graveyard onto the battlefield.

1308-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1124-1887-2793-2829-5089.manaNeeded: {4} on the first turn, with {9} available each subsequent turn
1124-1887-2793-2829-5089.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, and causes you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing any artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, revealing Ugin's Nexus from exile and putting it into your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

24-121-1167.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, gaining control of them during their next turn.
Move to their turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune for {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number for the opponent you control, and dealing that much damage to the opponent  if the oponent chose the largest number.
If the opponent didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

618-2154-2240.description:
Cast Sylvan Tutor by paying {G}, putting Kiki-Jiki on top of your library.
Activate Conspicuous Snoop's ability from Kiki-Jiki, creating a token copy of Conspicuous Snoop.
Activate the token Conspicuous Snoop's ability from Kiki-Jiki, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat the last step any number of times.

618-908-2887.notablePrerequisites: Scuttlemutt does not have summoning sickness.
618-908-2887.description:
Tap Scuttlemutt to make Kiki-Jiki every color.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1061-1564-1953.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
1061-1564-1953.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-1564-1953.description:
Cast Tempt with Reflections by paying {4}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.
